ex19.title: Inflation explained: why your savings buy less every year
ex19.reel_caption:
Inflation explained: your money can shrink without you spending a cent. 💸

At 10% inflation, what cost $1,000 now costs $1,100. Same money, less stuff. What to do: know your country's inflation rate, don't park long-term savings in cash, look for savings that pay interest (ideally above inflation), and build skills that raise your income.

📤 Send this to a friend who saves in cash
📌 Save it for later

Education, not financial advice.
